title: Retire or re-caller the sandbox executor's closed four-operation wrapper once xte's HTTP surface settles
body: After mn7, sandboxExecutorFromEnv/sandboxExecutor (the AttemptExecutor wrapper in sandbox-executor.ts) have no production caller — the door calls startNamedAttempt/namedAttemptStatus/sandboxExecutorDepsFromEnv directly, and collect is the Go side's from git. Kept deliberately (xte's note; the contract-shape tests hold the records to the pinned schemas). If the door never grows inspect/cancel routes, a later tick can retire the wrapper and keep the seams; if it does, this is the code it builds on.
